notes.title: Two years birthday update!
notes.notes:
Hello, players! We have not forgotten about the game and are working on new updates!

In this update, we have added two new Ruins and Storage maps, footstep sounds and test localization into several languages (it is made by machine, so errors may occur), as well as a small surprise traps that can be placed on the map.  



Good hunting!

notes.title: I'm Prop is out in Early Access!
notes.notes:
With confident steps, we have come to the release of the game in early access! 

First of all, we would like to thank everyone who supported us on this path. Without these people, we would not have been able to reach this stage. 

Now our humble team is already working hard on the first major update that will make serious changes to the gameplay. The image shows the first look at the new game map. 

We are also actively working on localization of the game. 

We also remind you that in case of any error, you can always inform us via any communication channels. We will fix it as soon as possible.

notes.title: Test update
notes.notes:
Hello, dear testers of our game! 

In today's patch, we broke a couple of old features, and added a bunch of new bugs.

- The camera now rotates normally in freeze mode (if you didn't know, the freeze is turned on by pressing the F button)
- You can now exit the windows in the main menu by pressing the Esc button.
- - Added the function of viewing objects through walls for props. (To be honest, this function was, but it didn't work).
- Now you can't get into a room with a password through Quick Play.
- And many more small changes.

The update weighs so much because particularly smart testers decided to look at the content of the game files, and we had to hang an encryption key on this case. Thanks to the very smart testers. 

Your Ruthenium Studio.
